text:
antonia_cs: Quick note  we saw a sustained backlog in the EU onboarding queue between 10:1410:38 UTC that delayed a handful of onboarding jobs. Affected tenants: T-4102, T-4110, T-4128, T-4133.

rahul_support: Noted. Customers reported long-running retries and some webhooks timed out. I kicked regional failover at 10:22 and queued replays for stalled batches.

mike_eng: From infra: S3 ingress rate-limiting combined with a pathological request shape produced head-of-line blocking in the ingest queue. We applied a short-term queue-priority fix and increased the ingress shard count at 10:29 which recovered throughput. Permanent fix in review, ETA ~4h.

antonia_cs: Drafting customer-facing note. Want to offer clear remediation + credit. Posting draft below  please mark edits.

antonia_cs: ```Hi <CustomerTeam>,

We're reaching out about a transient onboarding delay in the EU Dedicated environment on Mar 25 between 10:1410:38 UTC. During this time some onboarding jobs were delayed and you may have seen longer completion times or retry activity.

What we did: prioritized stalled onboarding jobs, initiated regional failover where appropriate, and increased ingress capacity to restore normal throughput.

Remediation we can offer: we will re-run any stalled onboarding batches on your behalf and provide a 30-minute troubleshooting session with an integration engineer. We will also apply a one-time billing credit that offsets compute consumed by retries during the impacted window.

Self-help: while we finalize the fix you may reduce batch_size to 3 and add a small retry_backoff (200ms) to reduce retry amplification. If you have strict data residency rules, reply and we will not enable cross-region routing without approval.

Next steps: we'll follow up with a technical RCA and the permanent fix timeline within 48 hours. Please reply if you'd like us to re-run stalled jobs or schedule the troubleshooting session.

Thanks,
Antonia (Customer Success) on behalf of Redwood Inference
```

jess_billing: Credit phrasing approved by legal: "A one-time credit equivalent to estimated retry compute for the affected window will be applied to your next invoice. If you'd like a custom review of usage, reply and we'll assist."

rahul_support: I'll send calendar invites for remediation slots Wed/Thu 14:00-16:00 UTC and attach diagnostics checklist. Also posting internal replay runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/onboard-replay (internal).

mike_eng: Addendum to draft: note that we ran targeted cache priming for active tenants which helped immediate throughput. Also include that we're adding a regression test to our CI to catch the request-shape pattern.

antonia_cs: Good catches  adding both lines and prepping EN/FR/DE localized copies. Tagging renewals: flag T-4133 high-touch for outreach; they had an extended retry window.

inc_bot: Incident 2026-03-25-EU-Onboard-Backlog created (P2). Lead: mike_eng.

antonia_cs: Sending now after localization. Will paste sent copy and recipients in thread and confirm credits applied. Thanks all :thumbsup:
